cards.ex: Some argue that art imitates life, reflecting our society's values and struggles.
cards.exUz: Ba'zilarning ta'kidlashicha, san'at hayotga taqlid qilib, jamiyatimizning qadriyatlari va kurashlarini aks ettiradi.
cards.uzDef: San'at asarlari ko'pincha real hayotdagi voqealarni aks ettiradi degan ma'noni anglatadi.

cards.ex: She always colored outside the lines, which made her art so unique and captivating.
cards.exUz: U har doim qoidalarga bo'ysunmasdan ijod qilardi, bu uning san'atini juda noyob va jozibali qilardi.
cards.uzDef: O'rnatilgan qoidalarga zid ravishda ijodiy fikrlash, standartlardan chetga chiqish.

cards.ex: Before starting the project, we need to conceptualize our ideas and create a detailed plan.
cards.exUz: Loyihani boshlashdan oldin biz o'z g'oyalarimizni shakllantirishimiz va batafsil reja tuzishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Abstrakt g'oyalarni tushunarli, aniq shaklga keltirish, rejalashtirish.

cards.ex: Visiting museums and reading books can fuel the imagination and broaden your horizons.
cards.exUz: Muzeylarga tashrif buyurish va kitob o'qish tasavvurni oziqlantiradi va dunyoqarashingizni kengaytiradi.
cards.uzDef: Tasavvur va ijodkorlikni kuchaytirish, yangi g'oyalar paydo bo'lishiga turtki berish.

cards.ex: In design, aesthetics matter just as much as functionality.
cards.exUz: Dizaynda estetika funksionallik kabi muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Go'zallik, did va uslubning ahamiyati, tashqi ko'rinishning muhimligi.

cards.ex: The judges debated the artistic merit of each painting before awarding the prize.
cards.exUz: Hakamlar mukofotni topshirishdan oldin har bir rasmning badiiy qimmatini bahslashdi.
cards.uzDef: San'at asarining badiiy jihatdan qanchalik qimmatli yoki muhim ekanligi.

cards.ex: The art exhibition was a visual feast, with paintings and sculptures from around the world.
cards.exUz: San'at ko'rgazmasi ko'z quvonchi edi, unda butun dunyo bo'ylab rasmlar va haykallar namoyish etildi.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli va zavqli ko'rinadigan narsa, ko'zni quvontiradigan manzara.

cards.ex: The artist is known for pushing creative boundaries with his experimental films.
cards.exUz: Rassom o'zining eksperimental filmlari bilan ijodiy chegaralarni kengaytirishi bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Ijod sohasida yangilik yaratish, odatiy usullardan chetga chiqish, yangi yo'llarni izlash.

cards.ex: Meditation can help you tap into your creativity and find new solutions to problems.
cards.exUz: Meditatsiya sizga ijodiy qobiliyatingizdan foydalanishga va muammolarga yangi yechimlar topishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining ijodiy qobiliyatlaridan foydalanish, ijodiy resurslarni ishga solish.

cards.ex: The song came to him in a stroke of inspiration while he was hiking in the mountains.
cards.exUz: Qo'shiq unga tog'larda sayr qilayotganda ilhom kelishi orqali keldi.
cards.uzDef: To'satdan paydo bo'lgan ijodiy g'oya, ilhomlanish lahzasi.

cards.ex: She's a leading figure in the creative realm, known for her innovative designs.
cards.exUz: U innovatsion dizaynlari bilan tanilgan ijodiy sohadagi yetakchi shaxs.
cards.uzDef: Ijod bilan bog'liq bo'lgan sohada, san'at, adabiyot va boshqa ijodiy yo'nalishlarda.

cards.ex: The director had a creative vision for the film that was unlike anything seen before.
cards.exUz: Rejissyorning filmga nisbatan ilgari ko'rilmagan ijodiy tasavvuri bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va o'ziga xos g'oyalarni tasavvur qilish qobiliyati, ijodiy qarash.

cards.ex: Painting is a form of artistic expression that allows me to communicate my emotions.
cards.exUz: Rasm chizish - bu badiiy ifoda shakli bo'lib, u menga o'z his-tuyg'ularimni etkazishga imkon beradi.
cards.uzDef: San'at orqali o'z fikrlarini, his-tuyg'ularini va g'oyalarini ifodalash.

cards.ex: The special effects team brought the fantasy creatures to life on the big screen.
cards.exUz: Maxsus effektlar jamoasi fantastik mavjudotlarni katta ekranda jonlantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni real, tirik yoki aniq qilish, g'oyani amalga oshirish.

cards.ex: The artist needed a creative spark to get started on his next project.
cards.exUz: Rassomga keyingi loyihasini boshlash uchun ijodiy uchqun kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: To'satdan paydo bo'lgan ijodiy g'oya yoki ilhom.

cards.ex: The new job offers a canvas of possibilities for career growth and development.
cards.exUz: Yangi ish faoliyat o'sishi va rivojlanishi uchun imkoniyatlar maydonini taklif qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Keng ko'lamli imkoniyatlar mavjud bo'lgan vaziyat yoki soha.

cards.ex: Everyone has their own artistic interpretation of the painting, which is what makes art so fascinating.
cards.exUz: Har kimning rasmga o'ziga xos badiiy talqini bor, bu san'atni juda qiziqarli qiladi.
cards.uzDef: San'at asarini o'ziga xos tarzda tushunish va izohlash.

cards.ex: The power of art lies in its ability to connect people and transcend cultural boundaries.
cards.exUz: San'atning kuchi odamlarni bog'lash va madaniy chegaralarni kesib o'tish qobiliyatida.
cards.uzDef: San'atning odamlarga ta'siri, his-tuyg'ularni uyg'otish, o'zgartirish va ilhomlantirish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Some consider 'Hamlet' to be a masterpiece in time, still relevant centuries later.
cards.exUz: Ba'zilar 'Hamlet'ni vaqt o'tishi bilan durdona deb hisoblashadi, u asrlar o'tgach ham dolzarbdir.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan o'z qimmatini yo'qotmaydigan, mashhur bo'lib qoladigan asar.

cards.ex: Writing a novel is a challenging but rewarding creative endeavor.
cards.exUz: Roman yozish qiyin, ammo mukofotli ijodiy harakatdir.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy faoliyat, san'at asarini yaratish yoki yangi g'oyalarni amalga oshirishga qaratilgan urinish.

cards.ex: The artist's surreal paintings stir the imagination and invite viewers to contemplate deeper meanings.
cards.exUz: Rassomning syurreal rasmlari tasavvurni uyg'otadi va tomoshabinlarni chuqurroq ma'nolarni o'ylashga taklif qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Tasavvurni faollashtirish, qiziqishni oshirish va yangi g'oyalarni paydo qilishga turtki berish.

cards.ex: Her passion for art led her to pursue a career as a museum curator.
cards.exUz: Uning san'atga bo'lgan ishtiyoqi uni muzey kuratori sifatida faoliyat yuritishga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: San'atga kuchli qiziqish, muhabbat va qadrlash hissi.

cards.ex: The young artist exhibited artistic talent beyond her years at the local art fair.
cards.exUz: Yosh rassom mahalliy san'at yarmarkasida o'z yoshidan kattaroq badiiy iste'dodni namoyish etdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining badiiy qobiliyatlarini ko'rsatish, namoyish qilish.

cards.ex: The chef added a touch of artistry to the dish with a beautiful garnish.
cards.exUz: Oshpaz chiroyli bezak bilan taomga badiiylik teginishini qo'shdi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy narsaga badiiy element qo'shish, uni yanada chiroyli va qiziqarli qilish.

cards.ex: The author skillfully crafted a narrative that kept readers on the edge of their seats.
cards.exUz: Muallif mahorat bilan o'quvchilarni hayajonda ushlab turadigan hikoya yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Voqeani yaratish, yozish yoki aytib berish, ko'pincha badiiy uslubda.

cards.ex: She has a strong artistic sensibility, which is reflected in her exquisite taste in art and design.
cards.exUz: U kuchli badiiy sezgirlikka ega, bu uning san'at va dizayndagi ajoyib didida aks etadi.
cards.uzDef: Go'zallikni his qilish, san'atni qadrlash va tushunish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: The meaning of the poem is open to interpretation, and each reader may find a different meaning.
cards.exUz: She'rning ma'nosi talqin qilishga ochiq va har bir o'quvchi turli xil ma'nolarni topishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil talqinlarga ega bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa, aniq ma'noga ega bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: She's a prominent figure in the art world, known for her groundbreaking installations.
cards.exUz: U san'at olamida taniqli shaxs bo'lib, o'zining innovatsion installyatsiyalari bilan tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: San'at bilan bog'liq bo'lgan odamlar, tashkilotlar va tadbirlar majmui.

cards.ex: Expressive arts therapy can be helpful for people struggling with emotional trauma.
cards.exUz: Ifodali san'at terapiyasi hissiy jarohat bilan kurashayotgan odamlarga yordam berishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini va fikrlarini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan san'at turlari (musiqa, raqs, teatr).

cards.ex: The creative process can be messy and unpredictable, but it's also incredibly rewarding.
cards.exUz: Ijodiy jarayon tartibsiz va oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan bo'lishi mumkin, ammo u juda ham foydali.
cards.uzDef: G'oyani shakllantirishdan tortib, uni amalga oshirishgacha bo'lgan bosqichlar ketma-ketligi.
